title: The Road to Zig 1.0 - Andrew Kelley
summary: Zig creator Andrew Kelley justifies why Zig exists and tours its distinctive features, including C interoperability and comptime, along with what people had built and what 1.0 would bring. It was given at Philly ETE 2019.
why: HN treats it as the standard introduction to Zig by its creator, with some calling it among the best talks they have seen.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Andrew Kelley's intro[0] is probably the best talk I've ever seen
